dedupe_keys.name: epa ireland municipal waste statistics generation treatment exports and recycling of municipal waste by material stream

description: These statistics describe how much municipal waste Ireland produces each year and what happens to it, by material, the official basis for the country's recycling and landfill targets. They are produced by the Environmental Protection Agency of Ireland from surveys and administrative returns and reported to Eurostat under the European waste directives. The latest release, in July 2026, covers 2024: about 3.1 million tonnes generated, a recycling rate of 43 percent, incineration with energy recovery for 41 percent and landfill for 15 percent. Tables break generation and treatment down by material stream (paper and cardboard, bio-waste, plastic, glass, metals, textiles, electrical equipment, bulky and mixed waste), with sections on exports for treatment, forecasts and outlook, and a national time series with gaps in 2013 and 2015. The figures are free and available on the web pages as tables and charts; no separate download file was seen on the page. Caveats: figures are national only, recent values are subject to further validation, and the series has gaps in 2013 and 2015. Simulation uses: setting national waste stream tonnages and treatment splits for waste system capacity models, and testing recycling and landfill diversion scenarios. Related records: Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives the harmonised European series, and the England ENV18 tables (data-defra-env18-local-authority-collected-waste) are a neighbouring national source.

name: EPA Ireland municipal waste statistics: generation, treatment, exports and recycling of municipal waste by material stream
schema_summary: Municipal waste generated by material stream (metals, glass, plastic, paper and cardboard, bio-waste, wood, textiles, WEEE, batteries, bulky, mixed, other), treatment by stream (material recycling, composting and anaerobic digestion, incineration with energy recovery, landfill), exports, recycling and landfill rates, forecasts and outlook; national time series from 2012 (no data for 2013 and 2015)

sources.note: Municipal waste statistics for Ireland, 2024 data released July 2026, submitted to Eurostat under the Waste Framework and Landfill Directives and the OECD/Eurostat Joint Questionnaire; 3,108,749 tonnes generated in 2024 (3,134,839 in 2023); 43% recycling rate (1.32 million tonnes); 15% landfill rate; 828,427 tonnes material recycling, 493,536 tonnes composting or anaerobic digestion, 1,278,279 tonnes incineration with energy recovery (41%); Table 1 generation by material stream; sections generation, treatment, exports, forecasts, outlook; no data for 2013 and 2015

EPA produces official statistics on waste generation and management from surveys and administrative data; guidance for waste reporters on waste codes, recovery and disposal codes and municipal waste types
